documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Sportking India reported strong performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by healthy demand across key markets, improved realizations, and stable raw material costs. The company's 150,000 spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing on schedule, with machinery erection underway and commercial production expected to start in the coming months. Management remains optimistic about the medium to long-term outlook, supported by strong global demand, favorable trade developments, and ongoing sustainability initiatives like the solar power project. Sportking India Limited reported its operational and financial performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, highlighting a revenue from operations of Rs. 781.1 crores for Q2 FY27 and Rs.

guidance.claim: The margins in the Odisha unit will be at least 4% to 5%, or maybe 6% higher than whatever is achieved once it is operational.
guidance.quote: So, our margins in Odisha unit will be at least 4% to 5%, or maybe 6% more than whatever we achieve once it is operational.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue to reach around INR 3,000 crores for the current financial year and exceed INR 4,000 crores in the next year with the new plant.
guidance.quote: So this year, last year, our top line was around INR2,500 crores. So this year, we are expecting somewhere around INR3,000 crores. So that's what 20% up. And next year, with the new plant, we see this going up to around more than INR4,000 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from export markets continued to be healthy, supported by improving business conditions across the global textile value chain.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from our export markets continued to be healthy, supported by improving business conditions across the global textile value chain.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from China and Bangladesh continues to be robust.
demand_outlook.quote: So the demand from China and Bangladesh continue to be robust and the Indian market was a little bit slow in last 2 months, 3 months, but with this festival season approaching and the spring production commencing after Diwali, which is traditionally the peak season for the domestic market.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has visibility for yarn demand until March 10th and it is pretty good.
demand_outlook.quote: So right now we have a visibility for the next till 10 March and it is pretty good.

demand_outlook.claim: India is highlighted as having a massive opportunity from the China plus one strategy utilized by developed countries like USA and EU.
demand_outlook.quote: A lot of developed countries are moving their suppliers from China to other major textile countries, India being the second largest cotton producer, is going to have a massive opportunity from this strategy utilized by developed countries like USA and EU.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from all markets continued to remain healthy, with supportive domestic demand expected in coming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from all the markets continued to remain healthy, and we are also encouraged by the outlook going into the second quarter. On the domestic front, we expect demand to remain supportive in the coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.

demand_outlook.claim: China has emerged as a significant buyer for Indian cotton yarn exports due to higher domestic cotton prices in China.
demand_outlook.quote: So most of the incremental demand, which has come into India for yarn export is from China. Bangladesh continues to be steady as they were. And China, we continue to see every month, we see them as a buyer.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000 spindle Greenfield expansion project in Odisha continues to progress on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On the strategic front are 150,000 spindle Greenfield expansion project in Odisha continues to progress on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: The entire machinery package for the Odisha project has been ordered and started arriving on site in a staggered manner.
capex_expansion.quote: The entire machinery package has been ordered and has started arriving on the site in a staggered manner.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production for the Odisha project is intended to start within the next 30 to 40 days.
capex_expansion.quote: Like, our Greenfield project to come in 8 months is a big achievement for us and we intend to start commercial production within next 30 days, 40 days.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed capex programme is expected to take 12-15 months to complete.
capex_expansion.quote: # Proposed capex programme to tak 12-15 months to complete

capex_expansion.claim: The solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations and are expected to reduce annual power costs by 12% to 15%.
capex_expansion.quote: I'm pleased to share that our solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations. This marks an important milestone in our journey towards sustainable and cost-efficient operations. The project is expected to reduce our annual power cost by approximately 12% to 15%, while simultaneously increasing the share of renewable energy in our overall power consumption.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing with the first phase of production expected to commence in the third quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Our 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is also progressing as planned. We are very excited with that. Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The solar project is projected to save approximately INR 15 crores on an annual run rate basis.
capex_expansion.quote: It should be around INR15 crores with this solar park, yes.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 15%.
margins_costs.quote: Beyond supporting our environmental goals, the project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects the margins to stay almost where they were in the first half for the next 6 months.
margins_costs.quote: So we expect the margins going at least for next 6 months, which we have the visibility for, we expect the margins to stay almost where we were in the first half.

margins_costs.claim: The old plant depreciation run rate is expected to be around INR 17 crores from next quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So from next quarter, we expect the run rate to be around INR17 crores – vis-à-vis INR24 in last quarter and INR14 in this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power plant is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.
margins_costs.quote: Commenced commercial operations of power supply on 18th June 2026 and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

margins_costs.claim: Overall yarn spread during the quarter was INR 133 per kg compared to INR 107 in the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So the overall spread was INR133 vis-a-vis INR107 last quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The Odisha plant will feature embedded incentives and subsidies, resulting in margins 300 to 400 basis points higher than older plants.
margins_costs.quote: So about EBITDA accretion, this plant has many incentives which are embedded. So we expect the margins coming out of that plant to be at least 300 to 400 basis points or even more than what we do in our old plants.

orders_capacity.claim: Existing facilities were operating at near full capacity during the quarter at 99%.
orders_capacity.quote: as the company is already cranking up at 99% capacity this quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company generally works on an 80 to 90 day order window.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, of course. See, we generally work on a window of 80 to 90 days, so we are sold in January and many days.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains an order book ranging between 70 to 90 days as part of its risk management policy.
orders_capacity.quote: We have an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days in any year, whether it is this year or even the last year or whichever year because this is our policy we work to manage our risk of having higher inventory.

capital_allocation.claim: The Odisha project includes a 30% capital subsidy paid in 5 equal installments, returning about INR 200 to INR 220 crores over 5 years on a INR 1,000 crores investment.
capital_allocation.quote: First is the capital subsidy, which we are going to get for 30% capital subsidy, which will be paid to us in 5 equal installments. On a INR1,000 crores investment, we are looking at about INR200 to INR220 crores coming back to us in 5 years.

capital_allocation.claim: By March 2027, the long-term debt is expected to be around INR 750 crores or less, about INR 700 crores, and working capital not exceeding INR 200 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, by March '27, we expect our peak debt to be -- the long-term debt to be, you can say, around INR750 crores, maybe less, about INR700 crores. And working capital, we don't expect to be spending more than INR200 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months.
risks_headwinds.quote: While global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months, we remain focused on prudent procurement and efficient inventory management.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to start commercial production of the Odisha Greenfield project within the next 30 to 40 days.
management_commitments.quote: Like, our Greenfield project to come in 8 months is a big achievement for us and we intend to start commercial production within next 30 days, 40 days.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to finish and start the whole Odisha project by the financial year end.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to by the end of this year, because are commissioning will start, it's a big project, it takes time and we and we expect to finish to start the whole project by the year end financial year end.

management_commitments.claim: The management expects to merge the fabric and garment companies and make them compliant within the next couple of months.
management_commitments.quote: So I think within next couple of months we intend to -- I think this will happen.

management_commitments.claim: The Odisha plant is expected to ramp up fully within 5 to 6 months and reach about 90% capacity utilization by March end.
management_commitments.quote: So we plan to start commissioning the plant somewhere in the next quarter. And we expect to ramp up the whole plant. It's a big plant. So it will take us around 5 to 6 months to fully ramp up. And I think by March end, we should be at about 90% capacity utilization for the whole plant.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to reach 96% to 97% capacity utilization for the Odisha plant by the start of the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Of course, that's our target that we want to reach 96%, 97% utilization by the start of the next financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The downstream acquisition impact is expected to start contributing around INR 250 crores from the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: and we expect the full impact start coming, which will be around INR250 crores from next financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
